reviews.comment: Dr. Hsiao is an incredibly sweet professor who is willing to put in SO much effort to help you out. She is quick to respond to emails and provides feedback on assignments. Yes, this class is hard, and the lectures can be difficult to follow because of the content itself, but if you put in the time to actually learn the material, you will do well!

Lectures are definitely difficult. Whoever said her lectures are good below probably has a 4.0, because all my friends & I had a difficult time in class. Wouldn't take her again if given the chance, but she has my respect for wanting to be a better professor, and you can tell she cares about her students. Tests are difficult, but she curves a lot.

People saying that she's a bad lecturer definitely didn't pay attention in class, or just didn't go (average class attendance was probably like 30%). She was fine at lecturing, and the lectures prepared you well enough for the exams in conjunction with the homework and study guides. The class material was not too complicated as long as you study.

Dr. Hsaio is new to teaching, and it shows. Her lectures are not terrible, but she prioritizes random facts rather than the entire topic, which makes her tests sporadic. The homework, worksheets, lectures, and tests do not correlate with one another. If she were more organized, the class would not have been as much of a headache as it was.

The material itself is pretty simple overall. 4 tests for 20% each. Everything you need to know for tests are from in-class worksheets and lecture slides. The only problem is you basically have to know/understand everything from the lecture slides because the tests cover a little bit of everything.

3 midterms and 1 final (20% each) make up 80% of your grade, remaining 20% is WileyPlus homework (terrible platform). Nearly impossible to fully prepare for exams due to excessive lecture material (does not seem focused, study guides all over the place). This class needs to be split into two courses, or change structure. Do not recommend.
Exams very difficult to prepare for. Promised us 5 EC points at the beginning of the semester, then ended up going back on it. Chaotic lectures as well. Try your best to take someone else.

I never learned anything in this course from the professor. The only thing useful she ever did was create exam reviews. The first exam we took in this class, no one turned in before time was up, since there was not enough time to finish the exam. She only ever talked to three students to answer questions for extra credit.

Most poorly organized course I have ever taken. Her lectures, the book, homework and most importantly the exams are all COMPLETELY uncorrelated. There is no way to study for tests or do better than a B because she will put exam questions over one bullet from a single slide out of 1000's presented during the course and provide no way to study.

reviews.comment: She is new to teaching, very kind, but the course is a mess. Tests are long, disorganized, and very hard to prepare for (short answer, multiple choice, free response, definitions, everything...). Her lectures cover way too many topics at once, you'll probably leave more confused. She often contradicts herself/is wrong on my occasions.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This woman is incredibly nice but it was her first semester teaching, which you could honestly tell. I think she'll get better with time, so I'd take her again. The first exam was very difficult to prepare for because the lecture material, homework, and exam material didn't match whatsoever. The homework is not helpful at ALL.
